title: HINGE CHOIR
description: Forty-eight coupled pendular levers behave as a tactile mechanical instrument. Grab any rod continuously, drag through an arc and release with real retained momentum; neighbouring levers exchange torque, weighted bobs collide, and a state-driven escapement can turn decay into sustained collective motion.

visual_finish.composition: a compact field of long weighted pendula reads as one mechanical instrument, with energy travelling through coupling and literal bob-to-bob impacts
visual_finish.material_model: dark steel rods, compact brass weights, restrained orange impact heat and soft mechanical shadows on warm instrument paper
detail_scales: individual rods, pivots and weighted bobs
